detours.note: SET_INTERFACE: interface 4 alt 1 brings the stream up, alt 0 down; others stock
GET_INTERFACE: interface 4 reports the alt setting the host asked for
class requests to the clock source (sample rate CUR/RANGE, validity); the rest STALL as stock
usb_ep0_send fills the dTD's buffer page 1 too: a configuration straddling a 4 KB page transmitted truncated
frame_isr's last instruction: the per-block producer (20 channels: tracks, MAIN, CUE; + the sum into the rings) and the packet builder
usb_isr UI path: retire EP3 IN completions, then USB MIDI's shim

pokes.note: device descriptor: class/subclass/protocol = interface-association composite

detours.note: knob handler 0x40055008: the store -- PTCH steps by scale degree
p-lock editor (TRIG held): the lock store -- PTCH steps by scale degree
CHROMATIC trig key -> pitch: transpose the key index by ROOT (a sample track: within -12..+12 st, the other position an octave below for ROOT G..B) and snap it to the scale
CHROMATIC key release on a paraphonic synth track (VOIC 2..4): the held-key mask decides the note-off
CHROMATIC key held + a new key: the LEG gate (the engine's po_legmode) -- mono legato keeps the held key with no voice note-off, paraphonic ends nothing, LEG OFF ends the note as stock

CHROMATIC key: mono legato = the trigless trig, the new key becomes the held key; paraphonic = a fresh voice, the key posted for the engine; paraphonic legato (LEG POLY) = the key joins the held set, po_legkey, the trigless trig
CHROMATIC key -> the live recorder: a legato press records a trigless trig, as FUNC + key does
CHROMATIC key recorded: note the step and the time; the release writes the note length as the HOLD lock
CHROMATIC key recorded, after its PTCH lock: the synth engine's po_keyrec recognises a fingered chord (PTCH root, CHRD, VOIC locks on the first key's step)
CHROMATIC key -> index: a synth track's index is the key itself (the octave is qz_oct)
FUNC + LEFT/RIGHT in CHROMATIC mode: a synth track's octave steps -4..+4 (qz_oct), stock's word stays 0
CHROMATIC drawer: a synth track draws the keyboard at stock octave 0 (the word is cleared)
CHROMATIC drawer: the octave number beside the keyboard is qz_oct on a synth track, the position 0 / 1 / -1 on a sample track, with ROOT's name before it when a scale is on
SEQUENCER window draw loop: index the row tables from the scroll offset
project loader entry: a storing load starts from SCALE = OFF, ROOT = C, GLIDE = OFF
project loader '#' line: read #SEQUENCER_SCALE=n / #SEQUENCER_ROOT=n / #SYNTH_GLIDE=n
project writer: #SEQUENCER_SCALE=n, #SEQUENCER_ROOT=n, #SYNTH_GLIDE=n after PATTERN_CHANGE_CHAIN_BEHAVIOR
boot: stock's sanitiser of the battery-RAM settings block -- SCALE/GLIDE/ROOT out of range -> OFF / C (core.s, ROM)
project defaults (cold boot, no project, before a load, new project): SCALE/GLIDE := OFF, ROOT := C (core.s, ROM)

pokes.note: SEQUENCER window: 3 -> 6 rows (SCALE, ROOT, GLIDE; 3 visible, scrolls)

detours.note: SET_CONFIGURATION body: bring EP2 up, 512-byte packets at high speed
usb_isr UI path: EP2 completions -> decode / re-prime / kick
midi_send entry: queue the message for the USB encoder
priority (realtime) byte sender: queue the byte for the USB encoder
CLEAR_FEATURE(ENDPOINT_HALT): answer for EP2 instead of stalling
config responder: clamp the reply to the grown configuration's length
other-speed responder: the same clamp
LFO engine (the routine) depth read: LFO 3 reads depth 0 on a synth track
LFO engine (the frame builder's inlined copy) depth read: the same
page resolver LFO descriptor: a synth track gets the VOIC/CHRD clone
MIDI IN note-on (the STANDARD map's chromatic block): a synth track's PTCH raw is note - 20 (semitones, 84 = 0), stored before the START, and the note is posted to the engine as a key of its own
MIDI IN note-off: a paraphonic synth track releases that note's voice alone; the last note's release posts the stock AMP release
the frame builder's AMP-release consumer (mailbox 0x40, every note-off path): a synth voice takes the released flag -- plan B: the engine's own release starts (po_mono_env)
the frame builder's STOP / restart word consumer (after the DSP all-off): every engine voice releases (plan B: the DSP's envelope ends nothing, so no note may stick)

the frame builder's copy of the DSP command byte into the packer's nibble byte (every START form's funnel): a START posted on a synth track whose engine voice is on (S_ON) becomes the key's clean form 0x30 -- the CF START bit with sub-frame position 0 -- so the DSP does not crossfade its old voice under the engine's one continuous stream (BUILD 37: the +5.6 dB bump at a sequencer trig on a still-sounding note)

the stock VOICE KILL's CF voice-byte clear (STOP / pattern change 0x40043c50, the loaders, the sample preview, the frame builder's end mask): the engine's voices of the killed track end at that instant (S_GAIN / S_GPREV / S_HTIM / S_ON := 0, the paraphonic voices freed) -- the DSP voice is dead, the next START is cold (BUILD 33)
MIDI IN note gate: a note outside 72..96 addressed to a synth track plays it chromatically (20..127 = -64..+43 semitones)
MIDI IN note-off gate: a note outside 72..96 addressed to a synth track reaches the chromatic note-off (po_moff)
MIDI IN live recorder (the 0x41 event): a synth track's note records through po_keyrec (fingered chords; the PTCH lock in semitones)
MIDI IN with a trig held: a synth track's held trig gets its PTCH lock in semitones

FUNC + UP/DOWN (the trig-mode selector): with a trig held on a synth track in GRID RECORDING, any trig mode, the held steps' PTCH lock moves an octave instead (no trig held, a sample track, GRID RECORDING off: the selector)
AMP SETUP window (FUNC + AMP) staging: an audio track stages the AMP clone whose sixth box is LEG (OFF / MONO / POLY on a synth track, OFF / MONO on a sample track; the master track stock)
AMP SETUP drawer: the page-2 names and formatters from the clone on an audio track
AMP SETUP drawer: the enable nibbles from the clone (the widget pass)
AMP SETUP drawer: the enable nibbles from the clone (the name pass)
AMP page-2 editor: slot 11 of an audio track steps LEG 0..2 (synth) or 0..1 (sample) (po_legknob); the Part byte and its battery-RAM shadow as stock writes them
AMP page-2 editor's live-lane write: a synth track's LEG never reaches the lane (the DSP's copy reads 0)

slot assigner (both windows): a track that becomes a synth track by this slot write -- FLEX with an FMSYNTH*/SYNTH* slot, not one before -- gets FINE 0c (RATE := 64 in the Part, its shadow and the live lane); a synth track already, or a sample track: untouched

file browser select: the slot's path write (stock's sprintf, called from the stub) -- a FLEX slot's file going non-marker -> FMSYNTH*/SYNTH* makes every FLEX track holding that slot a synth track: FINE 0c for each (the new-project case: T1 = FLEX slot 1, the first marker loaded into slot 1, no machine or slot byte changes)
